title: When Code Becomes Abundant: Rethinking Engineering Performance in the Age of AI
title_zh: 當代碼變得充裕：重新思考 AI 時代的工程績效
summary: AI coding tools are making engineering activity cheap to produce, hollowing out the signals managers have always used to judge performance. Five publications examine how engineering performance management must move upstream — from counting output to measuring judgment, uncertainty reduction, and difficulty retired.
summary_zh: AI 編程工具令工程活動變得廉價，掏空了管理者賴以判斷績效的訊號。五種出版角度剖析工程績效管理如何向上游轉移——由點算產出，轉向量度判斷力、降低不確定性與難度退役。
